gri_path: GRI 1: candidate headings differ at 4/6-digit level depending on missing facts

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of semiconductor machines only if no more specific heading; Section XVI note 2 would apply, uncertain

missing_facts: What is the O-ring made of (vulcanized rubber such as FKM/FFKM, PTFE plastic, metal)?
Is it a plain seal (4016.93, 3926.90) or a part of a specific machine?
classification.rationale: O-rings fall in 4016.93 (rubber), 3926.90 (plastic) or 8484 (gaskets sets/mechanical seals); material decides at the 6-digit level, so I abstained.
